title: The Tower of London ~$50 vs the Forbidden City ~$6 in Winter | China Travel Expert
description:
Two of the most famous historic sites on Earth, two very different prices. An adult walk-up ticket to the Tower of London runs about £37-38 — roughly $50 this winter. The Forbidden City in Beijing, from November through March, is just ¥40 — about $6. Same winter week, and Beijing's imperial palace comes in over eight times cheaper.

And it's not a small place for the money: the Forbidden City covers about 72 hectares with some 9,000 rooms — the largest palace complex in the world, and the home of 24 emperors across the Ming and Qing dynasties.

🧭 Expert Tip: visit between November 1 and March 31 for the ¥40 off-season rate (it's ¥60 the rest of the year), and book online — tickets are released about 7 days ahead and sell out.

故宫淡季（11月-3月）门票40元，约合6美元；伦敦塔成人票约50美元。同一个冬天，故宫便宜八倍多。
